headline: Fulham out of relegation zone by beating Coventry
description: Oscar Bobb's first Premier League goal for Fulham earned a 1-0 win over Coventry that lifted the Cottagers clear of the relegation zone.

headline: Arsenal's Konsa and Gabriel score to deny Everton
description: Centre-back partners Ezri Konsa and Gabriel celebrated personal milestones as Arsenal beat Everton 2-0 to move level on points with Premier League leaders Manchester City.

headline: Man City lose 100% Premier League record with defeat at Aston Villa
description: Manchester City suffered defeat for the first time in the Premier League this season when Nicolas Jackson's double earned Aston Villa a 2-1 victory at Villa Park.

headline: Premier League live updates: Arsenal defeat Everton, City lose unbeaten record to Villa
description: Arsenal move joint-top of the Premier League following Manchester City's defeat to Aston Villa, as another busy weekend of European soccer continues.

headline: Man City beaten by double from Aston Villa's Jackson
description: Nicolas Jackson scored twice to lead Aston Villa to a 2-1 win over Manchester City.
